character.appendages: Exactly one long tapered spike is attached to the crown and deforms with the body. No arms, hands, legs, wings, second horn, floating ornament or tail is permitted.
character.contactAndOrigin: Shared source origin is [22,34] on a 64x64 canvas. Compact cells remain low around that origin; upright, stretched, prone and displaced main062/main063 defeat cells retain their source-relative offsets without per-cell recentering.
character.faceAndExpression: The pale facial patch turns, compresses and partly disappears with body angle. Eye and mouth markings change between neutral, alert, effort/open-face, prone and silhouette states; one identical face must not be pasted across poses.
character.locomotion: Motion is driven by whole-body squash, tiny hops, upright rotation, diagonal lean, long forward stretch, prone collapse and displaced defeat. The single crown spike tilts, trails or lies back with the body; no new action meaning may be added.
character.morphology: Very small low round juvenile body with one long tapered flexible spike attached at the crown, one pale side/front facial patch and no torso limbs, wings or tail.
character.restraint: Main cells 027-043 are the donor-specific restrained contract, including aliases. A separate brown/gold wrap crosses the body through neutral, compressed, tall, open-face and prone states; main026 is the unbound pre-restraint low pose.
character.specialStates: Main044 and alias main046 are orange-red; main047 is the tall black silhouette; main048 is the compact black silhouette; main061 is stone-gray; main064 is the white evolution silhouette. These colors should be deterministic where source alpha relations permit.
